images.subject: A woman in her fifties, East Asian, with short greying hair and weathered skin.
images.outfit: Wearing a dusty white and grey mining work suit with orange accents and a reinforced collar.
images.detail: She holds up in one hand a raw rock sample streaked with silver metal veins.
images.site: Behind her, softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, the dark mouth of a mine tunnel cut into a grey rock cliff, with a massive ore conveyor and veins of raw metal in the rock.

images.subject: A man in his sixties, South Asian, with white hair and thin rimless glasses.
images.outfit: Wearing a long white and grey laboratory coat with blue accents.
images.detail: He holds a small glass vial containing a glowing blue crystal shard.
images.site: Behind him, softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, a bright research laboratory under a glass dome, with instruments and glass equipment.

images.subject: A woman in her thirties, Black, with short natural hair.
images.outfit: Wearing a white and grey work jacket with yellow accents and a utility harness.
images.detail: She holds a slim surveying instrument against her shoulder.
images.site: Behind her, softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, a monumental robotic factory hall with giant robotic arms assembling structural modules.

images.subject: A man in his forties, Latino, with a short dark beard and a strong build.
images.outfit: Wearing a heavy white and grey work suit with red accents and thick work gloves.
images.detail: A heavy wrench rests on his shoulder.
images.site: Behind him, softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, a large defensive gun turret on grey rocky ground, under repair.

images.subject: A woman in her fifties, North African, with short silver hair and a steady gaze.
images.outfit: Wearing a structured white and grey officer's work jacket with gold accents.
images.detail: She stands with her arms crossed.
images.site: Behind her, softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, a far-future colony of white domes and towers on a grey rocky plain, with construction cranes at work.

images.subject: A man in his forties, Northern European, with a short red beard and round glasses.
images.outfit: Wearing a white and grey laboratory coat with teal accents over a work suit.
images.detail: He holds a stack of thin sample plates.
images.site: Behind him, softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, a busy research laboratory with several researchers in white coats at their benches.

images.subject: A woman in her forties, Southeast Asian, with her black hair tied back.
images.outfit: Wearing a white and grey work suit with amber high-visibility stripes.
images.detail: Safety glasses hang from her collar.
images.site: Behind her, softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, an open-air shipyard cut into grey rock, with the large hull of a sleek far-future spacecraft under construction, built for space and not shaped like a boat.

images.subject: A man in his sixties, East African, with a short white beard and deep-set eyes.
images.outfit: Wearing a dark grey and white flight jacket with silver accents.
images.detail: He stands upright with his hands behind his back.
images.site: Behind him, softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, the wide window of a starship bridge showing deep space with stars and a distant nebula.

images.subject: A man in his forties, Latino, with a short dark beard and a strong build.
images.outfit: Wearing a heavy white and grey work suit with red accents and thick work gloves.
images.detail: He stands with his arms relaxed at his sides, his hands out of the frame.
images.site: Behind him, softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, a large defensive gun turret on grey rocky ground, under repair.

images.subject: A man in his forties, Latino, with a short dark beard and a strong build.
images.outfit: Wearing a heavy white and grey work suit with red accents and thick work gloves.
images.detail: He stands with his arms relaxed at his sides, his hands out of the frame.
images.site: Behind him, softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, a fixed defensive gun turret mounted on a round concrete pedestal anchored in grey rocky ground, with no tracks and no wheels, under repair.

images.subject: A man in his forties, Latino, with a short dark beard and a strong build.
images.outfit: Wearing a heavy white and grey work suit with red accents, with bare hands and no gloves.
images.detail: He holds a large adjustable wrench upright in his right hand in front of his chest, its head next to his shoulder.
images.site: Behind him, softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, a fixed defensive gun turret mounted on a round concrete pedestal anchored in grey rocky ground, with no tracks and no wheels, under repair.

images.subject: A man in his forties, Latino, with a short dark beard and a strong build.
images.outfit: Wearing a heavy white and grey work suit with red accents, with bare hands and no gloves.
images.detail: He holds a large adjustable wrench in his right hand, resting its handle on his shoulder, his elbow bent naturally.
images.site: Behind him, softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, a fixed defensive gun turret mounted on a round concrete pedestal anchored in grey rocky ground, with no tracks and no wheels, under repair.
